why: A model asked for 'a creative story' returns the same safe story every time, and several models return nearly the same one (studies of model writing, 2024-2025: outputs converge; asking for several labelled options, or drawing the options in code and handing them over as conditions, keeps them apart). So the code draws how each story direction opens, bends, looks and sounds from these axes, and the agent writes the story inside that draw. The values are kinds of storytelling, never a topic: they carry from a rocket to a gearbox.
rule: story_core.pick_directions draws n directions that differ on as many axes as there are: one closest to the user's taste (picks recorded in .studio/taste.json), one as far from it as the axes allow, one that prefers values not used before (kept outside the taste on purpose, so a taste does not narrow every video to one kind). A direction is a draw, not a template: the agent writes the beats, the axis values say what kind of story to write.

hook.means: what the first seconds show, before anything is explained

result_first.means: the end result or the key moment first, then how it came to be
result_first.example: the finished thing working, then rewind

question.means: a question the viewer cannot answer yet, asked over a striking picture
question.example: why does this not fall over?

failure.means: what goes wrong without the mechanism: a crash, a break, a miss

scale_shock.means: a size, speed or number made visible against something familiar
scale_shock.example: a person beside it, a car under it

myth.means: a common belief shown, then about to be overturned
myth.example: most people think it works like this

countdown.means: a clock or a distance running down to a moment that must go right

arc.means: how the middle bends: where the tension rises and what releases it

problem_solution.means: a problem made hard, then the mechanism that solves it, then proof it works

failure_then_success.means: an attempt that fails, why it failed, the change, the attempt that works

journey_with_the_flow.means: ride with what moves through the thing - each part met because the flow reaches it and changed by it - to the place that matters most (2026-10-19: was journey_through_parts, part by part, which wrote a parade of parts)

journey_through_parts.means: a path through the thing, part by part, to the part that matters most
journey_through_parts.retired: 2026-10-19: it wrote a parade of parts; never drawn again, kept so stories and rounds drawn with it still read (journey_with_the_flow)

myth_busting.means: the belief, the evidence against it, the real reason, the reveal

countdown_to_moment.means: steps against a clock, each one closer, the moment itself as the peak

angle.means: whose eyes the story is told through

object_pov.means: from the thing itself or riding along with it

observer.means: a watcher at a distance who sees the whole event

engineer_explains.means: close to the mechanism, the parts opened and named

comparison.means: two things side by side: before and after, this and that

thread.means: the one thing the viewer keeps hold of from beat to beat, which decides their order and stays on screen (story.thread; reel_flow THREAD_OFF_SCREEN)
thread.device_shots_means: per kind, the devices a shot field makes: {device words: {path (dotted, lists read through), in | min | any}}, what a built shot holds when it uses the device (reel_flow THREAD_DEVICE_UNUSED: a reel none of whose shots uses one). A device not listed is words only.

moving.means: something that travels through the thing - water, a force, a signal, a chain link - followed from where it starts to where it ends
moving.orders_by: space: where does it go next
devices: a section opened where it is
a flow arrow on its path
a camera that rides or pans with it

time.means: events in the order they happened, the same thing seen again as time passes
devices: the date or the clock on screen
the same object shown again in a new state or a new look
a still that holds the turning point

question.means: an investigation: a puzzle, its suspects and clues, each ruled in or out
devices: what is ruled out marked so
the answer shown where the clues pointed

change.means: one thing before and after: what is different and what made it so
devices: the same framing before and after
split screen or a wipe between them
the moment of change held still

failure.means: what goes wrong without the mechanism, and each consequence that follows
devices: the mechanism restored and the failure not happening

scale.means: a ladder of sizes: from the part to the whole system, or from the whole down to the smallest piece
scale.orders_by: size: one step wider or closer each beat
devices: each shot one step wider (or closer) than the last
the earlier size marked inside the next
a return to the first size at the end

tense.means: stakes and suspense, short cuts near the peak

playful.means: light, surprising, a wink at the viewer

stake.means: what the viewer has riding on how it turns out - whose, and what is lost if it goes wrong (story.stake; story_core.stake_lint). Added 2026-10-20: the planned stories that lost to the study set were judged 'a tour, nothing at stake'

personal.means: the viewer's own day: their commute, their meal, their sleep, their phone
personal.example: the train you are on stops in the tunnel

public.means: a whole city or crowd that depends on it working at once
public.example: a million flushes at half time

safety.means: someone gets hurt if it fails
safety.example: the brake that must hold on the steepest street

cost.means: money or material lost when it goes wrong, or saved when it goes right
cost.example: a ship stuck in the lock, a day of trade lost

time.means: a moment that must not be missed, a clock that runs out
time.example: the bread must rise before the oven is free
